name: Ferienwohnungen Schloss Hohenstaffing
beschreibung:
Nestled within expansive castle parklands near Kufstein, Schloss Hohenstaffing welcomes guests with stately elegance and sensitively renovated holiday apartments. The stylish residences unite historic architecture with contemporary luxury.

Its serene setting ensures complete relaxation, while Kufstein Fortress and the Kaiser mountain trails are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnungen Schloss Hohenstaffing near Kufstein offers historic castle ambiance and exclusive living comfort in Kufsteinerland.
